name: Faaslay
overview: Zaviyar and Ainy, best friends since childhood, bound by love but torn apart by ego and misunderstandings.  Ainy dreams of owning her own restaurant, while Zaviyar, a rich architect, lives in a world far from hers. When class, pride and family conspiracies collide, destiny forces them into marriage, a love they always wanted but never confessed. Will they overcome their Faaslay (distances) and choose love over ego?
